org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.ui

Class AsyncController

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.ui.AsyncController
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable

    @Named
public class AsyncController
extends Object
implements Serializable
    JSF Controller class continuously polled during a procedure execution; checks all display queues and user reponses and sets states accordingly.
    Author:
    smichaels
    See Also:

      Methods 
      Modifier and Type Method and Description
      void asyncListener()
      This method is called through ajax by the procedureExecutionPoller component within procedurePerspective.xhtml This is the event loop for asynchronously initiated events This method calls checkUserPrompt() - checks UserPromptMgmt for pending prompts, and displays them if required checkVisualizationDisplays() - checks GraphicDisplayMgmt for pending visualization displays, and displays them if required checkProcedureStatus() - checks for additions to the status log StatusLogController and appends these as required checkFrameDisplay() - checks for new frames to display, marking instructions, etc checkCameraDisplay() - updates the camera display with most recent data checkMessages() - if a procedure exception is detected, displays the procedure abort exeception checkIsWaiting() - waits for user input to a dialog and if exceeds threshold, begins to play annoying reminder sound checkSubProcedureStart() - checks the ProcedureExecutionState if a subprocedure start is requested and sets up user interface to reflect new subprocedure data checkSubProcedureEnd() - checks the ProcedureExecutionState if a subprocedure end is requested and sets up user interface to reflect previous super-procedure data onComplete() - sets up display and state to render the procedure as completed

      • asyncListener

        public void asyncListener()
        This method is called through ajax by the procedureExecutionPoller component within procedurePerspective.xhtml This is the event loop for asynchronously initiated events This method calls
        • checkUserPrompt() - checks UserPromptMgmt for pending prompts, and displays them if required
        • checkVisualizationDisplays() - checks GraphicDisplayMgmt for pending visualization displays, and displays them if required
        • checkProcedureStatus() - checks for additions to the status log StatusLogController and appends these as required
        • checkFrameDisplay() - checks for new frames to display, marking instructions, etc
        • checkCameraDisplay() - updates the camera display with most recent data
        • checkMessages() - if a procedure exception is detected, displays the procedure abort exeception
        • checkIsWaiting() - waits for user input to a dialog and if exceeds threshold, begins to play annoying reminder sound
        • checkSubProcedureStart() - checks the ProcedureExecutionState if a subprocedure start is requested and sets up user interface to reflect new subprocedure data
        • checkSubProcedureEnd() - checks the ProcedureExecutionState if a subprocedure end is requested and sets up user interface to reflect previous super-procedure data
        • onComplete() - sets up display and state to render the procedure as completed
